items.passage: Transcript: Hi, this is Ilse Marchetti from the campus recycling programme, with two changes for this term. First, collection times at the residence halls. Compost, which has always gone out on Monday mornings along with everything else, will now be collected on Wednesday mornings, because our new compost hauler only serves this part of town midweek. Mixed recycling stays on Mondays, but the truck will come in the afternoon, so please put those bins out after lunch. Second, old electronics. You may be used to leaving phones and cables in the grey bin outside the dining hall. That bin has been removed. The electronics recycler now charges us per visit, so we'll book a single pickup at the end of term. Until then, please keep old devices in your room. Batteries are different: they still go in the yellow tub at your hall's front desk, and used printer cartridges still go to the campus mail room. Questions? Call extension 3196.
